interface.title: MO Agri — Baseline + Fields (Missouri agricultural monitoring — local dashboard)
interface.field: Agronomy / agricultural remote sensing (crop yield, MODIS & Sentinel NDVI, SAR, Daymet weather)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring and monitoring data: looking back over historical yields and checking current satellite signals against them
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse Missouri county crop yields, MODIS NDVI history and weather–yield correlations from 2001 to 2025, and watch recent Sentinel-2 NDVI and Sentinel-1 SAR for three monitored fields and 114 cropland-masked counties.
interface.note: The README's headline modelling outputs (Ridge vs GBR R²/RMSE, GBR feature importances, residuals by county) are static figures in the repository and do not appear in this dashboard, so this tree does not cover them.

data.note: Cached data that ships with the app: 7,890 USDA NASS yield rows, 116 counties, 8 crops, 36,064 MODIS NDVI observations (2001–2025), Daymet correlation maps, 3 field AOIs with prepared NDVI/SAR tiles and 2024 time series, and county Sentinel series up to 2026-04-20. Nothing was uploaded.

tree.general: Understand how vegetation and weather relate to crop yield across a region, and check current crop condition against history
tree.specific: Inspect Missouri county corn/soy yields, MODIS NDVI and Daymet correlations, and monitor field and county Sentinel NDVI/SAR

features.name: Year-range slider driving an aggregated point map
features.general: Pick a span of time with a two-handle slider or typed bounds, and see a map of each location's average value over that span, with hover details
features.specific: Use the Year range RangeSlider and its paired number boxes to redraw the 'Corn yield — avg Y1-Y2' county bubble map, with colour and size showing bu/acre. Typed bounds apply only when the box loses focus; the map always shows corn whatever the Commodity dropdown says; box-select only dims other counties; slider dragging was not re-tested by the replay
steps: Type the start and end years in the boxes and move focus away, or drag either slider handle
Collapse both handles onto one year to see a single season
Hover a bubble to read the county, bu/acre, lat and lon
Box-select counties to highlight them (others dim; no other panel changes)
Download the map as a PNG
serves_tasks: Map the average yield per area unit over a chosen span of years
Check whether known bad years show up as dips in the regional trend

features.name: Category trend line with spread band and event markers
features.general: Choose a category and see its regional mean over time, with a ±1σ band across units and dashed lines marking notable years
features.specific: Use the Commodity dropdown to redraw 'MO statewide mean (bu/acre)' with a ±1σ band across counties and dashed lines at 2012, 2018 and 2022. Legend toggles reset when the chart redraws; the title says 2001–2023 but points run through 2024
steps: Choose a commodity (Corn, Cotton, Hay, Oats, Rice, Sorghum, Soybeans, Wheat)
Read the dips at the marked years
Hover a year to read the mean
Click a legend entry to hide the band or the line (the toggle is lost on the next redraw)

Compare the trend for another commodity

features.name: Small-multiple per-unit correlation maps
features.general: Three side-by-side point maps of per-unit Pearson r, each with its own diverging colour scale, comparing weather against outcome and weather against a vegetation index
features.specific: Static county maps r(TMAX July, corn yield), r(PRCP May–Aug, corn yield) and r(TMAX July, NDVI July) for 85 counties, 2001–2023, with a caption giving sign counts (July heat negative in 84/85, May–Aug rain positive in 81/85). Fixed images with no controls
steps: Scroll to the correlation section
Read each map's title and diverging colour scale
Compare the sign pattern across the three maps against the caption counts
serves_tasks: Read per-unit correlation maps between growing-season weather and yield (read-only)

With the shipped data the z-score and vegetated-hectare rows show '—' ('no baseline yet (1 prior yr)'), so the anomaly step is displayed but not working; the NDVI band is drawn as a diagonal wedge across a July data gap

Read the latest NDVI and VV tiles and their dates
Read the metrics table: acreage, vegetated ha, latest NDVI, NDVI z-score, latest VV dB, VV z-score (z-scores and vegetated ha show '—' here)
